name: Vocus
summary: Business and wholesale telco; grew via acquisitions into a major ISP/backbone player (VOCUS GROUP LIMITED, ACN 084 115 499).

events.details: ASX-listed (VOC) from 1999 (as First Wine Fund, renamed Vocus Communications 2010, Vocus Group 2017); taken private 23 Jul 2021 via scheme of arrangement (Macquarie Infrastructure/PSP Investments consortium, $5.50/share).
